purpose: Independent verification requirements for the Ferrosift10-video investor demonstration. This contract does not report a newly run benchmark.

scope.candidate: Fine-tuned Ultralytics YOLO26s, selected development configuration
scope.claim_scope: Paired visual detection comparison on the identified clips. No commercial-sorter comparison, physical recovery or field-readiness claim.
scope.independence: Independent review is distinct from independent data. Label each clip separately as untouched holdout, exposed development/diagnostic, repeated source objects, unknown, or qualitative only.

frozen_operating_point.rule: class_id == 1 and score >= threshold AFTER frozen common class-aware NMS
frozen_operating_point.selection_history: Both thresholds and candidate configuration were selected on the 1522-frame development set under a 1% conservative alarm-burden constraint. This is development selection, not a test guarantee.
frozen_operating_point.changes: No per-clip thresholds or post-test selection. Any new setting is a separately identified exploratory run; it cannot replace the frozen result. Keep original checkpoints and all negative runs.

inventory_required_per_clip: clip_id, original source URL/citation, release/version, acquisition permission, license/attribution and redistribution status
original file SHA256, decoded dimensions, codec, original presentation timestamps/timebase, duration, original capture rate if known
source session/run, physical-object group IDs if verified; training/validation/test and prior-viewing/use history
complete frame-selection manifest: frame_id, original_timestamp_s, scored/displayed status, decoded-pixel hash; crops/re-encoding/resampling provenance
ground-truth source/hash/version, supported classes and mapping, annotation completeness by frame/region/class, blind-review status
annotation type: complete boxes/masks, audited passage tracks, partial positives, or absent; ignored regions and exclusion counts
raw continuous recording versus extracted stills/slideshow; selection reason registered before results
freeze_manifest_required: run_id, protocol SHA256, UTC freeze time and prior-exposure declaration
all clip/annotation manifests, exclusions and exact eligible frame sets
both checkpoint/config hashes, training/pretraining provenance, code revision, evaluator/dependency versions
input color conversion/resize/letterbox/ROI, class mapping, confidence floor, NMS/head choice, max detections, thresholds
tracker/association/aggregation rules, ROI/decision line/deadline, missing-frame rule and event deduplication
primary endpoint/unit, false-alarm budget and allowed degradation if any, uncertainty method, all planned subgroup reports

paired_execution.accuracy: Both models consume the same decoded source pixels and eligible frame IDs. Use the shipped common 640-square/FP32/batch-1/NMS path unless a separately disclosed benchmark configuration was frozen before testing. No ground-truth crops, future-frame rescue or different input enhancement.
paired_execution.runtime: Same named machine/device, backend, package versions, numerical precision, batch size, input shape and measured thread settings. Run models separately, not contending side by side. Warm up identically; alternate model order across at least 3 complete passes. Report every pass and cold-start separately. This measures runtime variation, not new accuracy samples.
paired_execution.failure: Do not omit failed or skipped frames. Report errors/drops; eligible GT in an unprocessed frame remains missed in the complete-input system score. A partial run is incomplete and cannot be a completed benchmark.
paired_execution.architecture: Record exact inference head/end2end/NMS mode. A newer architecture does not establish better scrap detection, and a common architecture name does not verify checkpoint identity.
paired_execution.numeric_drift: Record platform and near-threshold decisions. Reproduction tolerance applies only to declared numeric differences; never move the threshold to restore a preferred count. If backend/platform changes the strict result, publish the new observed result with its runtime provenance.

frame_scoring.unit: One independently annotated class instance in one scored frame. The same physical piece appearing again is another annotation, not another recovered object.
frame_scoring.eligibility: Use all predeclared fully annotated eligible frames/regions, including negative/empty-belt frames. Prespecify ignore/crowd rules. Ground truth is model-blind; unknown or excluded areas have recorded counts/coverage.
frame_scoring.matching: At IoU >= 0.50, match each class separately with one-to-one score-descending greedy matching to unmatched nonignored ground truth; deterministic stable tie-break by prediction ID then GT ID. Freeze implementation and edge cases. Wrong class: FP for predicted class and FN for true class; duplicate target boxes beyond one match are FP. Keep class-agnostic error-attribution matching separate from TP/FP counts.

definitions.tp: Matched predicted target instances at the frozen operating threshold
definitions.fp: All retained predicted target instances not matched to eligible target GT, excluding only predeclared legitimate ignored regions
definitions.fn: Eligible target GT instances not matched at that threshold, including eligible dropped-frame GT
definitions.precision: tp / (tp + fp); null when no predictions
definitions.recall: tp / (tp + fn); null when no target GT
definitions.false_target_boxes_per_1000_scored_frame: 1000 * fp / scored_frame_count; null if frame count is zero
definitions.steel_matched_as_target_fraction: distinct eligible steel GT matched to a target prediction / eligible steel GT; only if steel annotations are complete
definitions.conservative_alarm_burden_per_steel_anno: (steel-matched target predictions + other-class-matched target predictions + unmatched target predictions) / steel GT, with categories separately visible; not conventional FPR or steel mass loss

frame_scoring.false_alarm_attribution: After target TP matching, separately classify remaining FP as steel match, other annotated class match, duplicate on target, background/unmatched, or unknown coverage. Categories must be exclusive and sum to FP. Do not let many duplicates on one steel instance inflate a claimed steel-object error fraction.

ap.evaluator: Pinned pycocotools COCOeval bbox; explicit category mapping, imgIds, area=all, maxDets=[1,10,100], ignore/crowd policy; store version and full parameters.
ap.AP50: Interpolated precision-recall integral for each class at IoU 0.50 over the saved score-ranked predictions; not precision at the displayed threshold.
ap.AP50_95: Average AP over IoU 0.50,0.55,...,0.95. Report copper AP separately; mAP is the mean over named eligible classes.
ap.input: Use all detections retained by the frozen common pipeline above its 0.001 score floor, not only strict-threshold alarms. Report score truncation and detector max_det=1000 alongside evaluator maxDets=100. If counts exceed evaluator limits, retain this standard result and add a clearly named, predeclared higher-cap diagnostic.
ap.nulls: No GT for a class => AP null (not 0 or 100%). Positive GT with no predictions => AP=0. Missing/incomplete GT => affected AP null.
ap.aggregation: Per-clip AP and pooled-all-eligible-frame AP are separate outputs; pooled AP is recomputed from predictions, not an arithmetic average of clip AP.

frame_scoring.aggregation: Publish every registered clip. Pooled precision=sum(tp)/sum(tp+fp); pooled recall=sum(tp)/sum(tp+fn). Do not present mean clip recall as pooled recall. Keep development, exposed diagnostic and untouched holdout pools separate.
frame_scoring.uncertainty: Frames are correlated. Report raw counts; never calculate independent-binomial confidence from repeated frames. Paired uncertainty resamples independent source/session or verified physical-object groups, retaining both models and repeated views. With inadequate independent groups, label comparative evidence descriptive/inconclusive.
frame_scoring.ground_truth_geometry: Use bbox IoU for this detector comparison. Convert any polygon/mask annotation once to a deterministic tight axis-aligned box in original pixel coordinates, save the conversion/version and class remapping, and verify image bounds. Segmentation AP requires mask predictions and is a different named metric.

passage_scoring.availability_gate: Requires independently audited GT object-passage identities/labels, full temporal coverage and a frozen causal decision policy. Predicted tracker IDs alone are not truth.
passage_scoring.ids: Separate frame_annotation_id, gt_passage_id, predicted_track_id and verified physical_piece_id. Repeated passages of one piece are repeatability observations and clustered for uncertainty.
passage_scoring.decision: At most one credited positive decision per GT passage before its source-time deadline. Missing detection, abstention without diversion and late-only detection are misses. Missing source samples cannot be filled with GT.
passage_scoring.precision: correct unique target decisions / all emitted target commands; false non-target commands, phantom commands and duplicate commands are reported and count against command precision. A late first command can be both a missed on-time target and an unsuccessful command.
passage_scoring.recall: target GT passages with at least one valid on-time decision / all eligible target GT passages
passage_scoring.steel_false_route_fraction: distinct steel passages receiving an erroneous removal decision / all eligible steel passages; non-target categories remain visible
passage_scoring.phantom_rate: commands not associated with any GT passage / fully audited source minutes
passage_scoring.duplicate_rate: excess commands beyond the first for each GT passage / fully audited source minutes
passage_scoring.display: If no actuator/bin measurement, call these software decisions or simulated route commands, never objects recovered or copper saved.
passage_scoring.unverified_identity: Show predicted tracks only; unique-object accuracy, actual unique object counts and sorting outcomes remain null.

ground_truth_modes.complete_frame_annotations: Enable frame precision/recall/AP; event results remain null unless passage gate also passes.
ground_truth_modes.audited_passage_annotations_only: Enable passage decisions if policy/deadlines are defined; frame AP stays null without localization GT.
ground_truth_modes.partial_positive_annotations: Only a clearly scoped diagnostic recall on the labeled positives may be shown. Precision/AP/FPR, full-clip recall and winner badges stay null because unannotated objects cannot be classified as false alarms.
ground_truth_modes.none: Show timestamped predictions and actual measured runtime only. Precision, recall, AP, accuracy, uplift, winner and measured copper/money saved are null.
ground_truth_modes.model_generated_labels: Not independent ground truth. Human model-blind audit is required before benchmark use; preserve annotation provenance.

playback_and_timing.display: Both panels show identical source frame ID/timestamp under shared play/pause/seek/step. Keep source timestamp, playback clock and inference wall time separate. Show source age for reused predictions. Replaying or seeking never increments finalized counts.
playback_and_timing.playback_speed: A playback multiplier changes display only. Cached overlays at video speed do not demonstrate inference throughput.
speed_outputs: source duration / wall duration real-time factor
playback_and_timing.scoping: Model-only inference FPS excludes other work and must say so. Offline faster-than-duration throughput is not proof of bounded live latency. A 100-fps original sampled at 20 fps is reported as that sampling policy, not a 100-fps inference claim.
playback_and_timing.physical_calibration: No m/s, kg/h, tonnes/h, ejection success or physical real-time sorting claim without measured belt encoder/speed, spatial calibration at belt plane, original timestamps, camera-to-actuator geometry, actuator delay/jitter, load/weights and output-bin evidence. Edited/slowed video or pixels/frame cannot establish these.
playback_and_timing.deadline: Only with calibration: remaining physical travel time - measured actuator delay - declared safety margin. Time-varying speed needs encoder-based travel, not one nominal FPS conversion.

result_decision.primary_endpoint: Freeze one supported endpoint before results; prefer on-time target-passage recall at a declared non-target-command budget when GT allows. Otherwise use visible-copper frame-annotation recall and say so.
result_decision.candidate_higher: Show signed observed difference and both false-alarm outcomes. Any supported superiority statement requires preregistered constraints and suitable paired uncertainty.
result_decision.reference_higher: Show the reference advantage in the same units and styling; retain the clip and signed negative candidate difference. No hidden substitution, threshold retuning or zero-clamping.
result_decision.mixed_or_uncertain: Show tradeoff or inconclusive. Higher recall with more false alarms is not an unqualified win.
result_decision.tie: Show tie at declared numeric tolerance; round for display only, never for outcome decisions.
result_decision.selected_examples: A curated illustration may be clearly labeled and linked to the full all-clip results, including losses; it cannot supply an independent headline score.
result_decision.prohibited: No always-win guarantee, hardcoded positive result, inferred missing metrics, rebranded commercial comparator, forced candidate rank or hidden unfavorable input.

copper_value_scenario.persistent_label: Illustrative copper-value scenario. Assumptions only; this video does not measure copper mass recovery or savings.
copper_value_scenario.no_metric_binding: Never bind frame recall, AP, object-count recall, box area, predicted confidence, counted frames or replay elapsed time to copper kilograms or money. Equal copper mass per visible piece is an unverified scenario assumption, not a measurement.
copper_value_scenario.provenance: Each input is explicitly user-assumed or independently measured with source/date, units and range. Null never silently becomes a favorable default.
copper_value_scenario.formula_incremental_payable_value: feed_kg_per_hour * operating_hours * contained_copper_mass_fraction * (assumed_candidate_copper_mass_recovery * candidate_payability_fraction - assumed_reference_copper_mass_recovery * reference_payability_fraction) * price_currency_per_kg
copper_value_scenario.formula_scenario_contribution: incremental_payable_value - incremental_processing_cost - lost_non_target_value - annualized_capital_cost (all over the same period; otherwise null)
copper_value_scenario.negative_results: Preserve negative quantities and values; label incremental value/loss, never guaranteed savings.
copper_value_scenario.measurement_upgrade_gate: Measured mass recovery requires representative weighed input/output streams, independent copper assays and declared material-balance closure; recovery = target-product copper mass / input copper mass. Include dust/residue/reject streams. Matched controlled sorting trials, buyer payability and complete incremental cost are needed for a savings claim.

minimum_deliverables: per-clip and pooled metrics.json/CSV with units/denominators/null reasons
complete continuous paired demo with evidence/limitations panel

required_metric_record.alarm_burden_per_steel_annotation: nonnegative number or null; may exceed 1
required_metric_record.null_reasons: map from null field to reason

automated_acceptance_assertions: All present hashes verify; settings/thresholds match manifest and run logs; no test-dependent edits.
Identical eligible frame manifests/pixel hashes for both models; no missing/unreported clip or source frame.
Per clip and class: n_target_gt == tp + fn; n_predictions == tp + fp; exclusive FP categories sum to fp.
Null conditions enforced; no-GT footage cannot emit performance scores or winners.
Pooled counts exactly sum included clip counts and preserve evidence tiers; AP recomputed from ranked predictions.
Replay, backward seek, restart and speed change leave final counts unchanged; both panels remain source-aligned.
Dropped/errored frames, zero detections, duplicate boxes, wrong classes, ignored regions and empty clips have fixture tests.
Reference-win, negative-difference, zero-reference-misses, tie, all-empty and mixed-tradeoff display fixtures pass.
No divisions by zero, NaN/Infinity or fabricated 100% for empty denominators; use null with reason.
Economic scenario is a separate assumption namespace with no binding to benchmark recall; negative economic results remain negative.
Source-video license/attribution and deployed checkpoint/code-license route reviewed; unresolved distribution rights block distribution, not read-only audit.

historical_reproduction.metric_namespace: historical_routing_alarm_diagnostic; keep separate from newly computed standard detection metrics
historical_reproduction.matching: Original diagnostic sorts target alarms by descending score, lexicographic xyxy, then prediction index; assigns highest-IoU unmatched GT of ANY class at IoU>=0.5, GT-row tie-break; reveals class after assignment. This differs from class-specific detection/AP matching. Retain the original matcher to reproduce published counts; do not silently relabel or recompute them under a different matcher.
historical_reproduction.excluded_frames: Six official validation frames lacked acquired labels, leaving 1522 of 1528. Missing labels were not treated as empty belt. Preserve the six-frame exclusion ledger and report coverage.
historical_reproduction.protocol_precedence: The copied inference_protocol.json records an earlier 5%/native-postprocessing experiment. Current bundle settings.json, strict_development_metrics.json and README define the shipped 1% common-NMS strict configuration. Do not apply the historical protocol’s 5% ceiling or native/end-to-end choices to the shipped comparison.
historical_reproduction.runtime_caution: Historical torch_threads=4 records a requested pre-setup value, not verified actual runtime thread count. No historical 4-thread/deployment speed claim is supported.
historical_reproduction.evidence_status: Package hashes and arithmetic checked here; no inference rerun, video decoding, unseen-data audit, new independent test or measured recovery performed.
